privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how ADVANCE DETAILING CO. processes personal data when you visit this website or contact us.

p: The data controller is ADVANCE DETAILING CO., Xhevat Qena, Prishtina 10000, Kosovo. Email: info@advancedetailingco.com, Phone: +383 (0) 49 909 229.
Data is processed in accordance with Law No. 06/L-082 on the Protection of Personal Data of the Republic of Kosovo and, where applicable, the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

The legal bases we rely on are: your consent (e.g. contact form, external media, analytics), pre-contractual steps taken at your request, and our legitimate interest in operating the website securely.
Contact form: your full name, email address and the content of your message.
Technical data: the hosting provider may log your IP address, browser type and time of visit in server logs for security purposes.
Preferences: your language, theme and consent choices are stored only in your browser (localStorage).
We use data only to respond to your enquiries, arrange appointments and keep the website running. We do not sell your data and do not use it for advertising without your consent.

Form messages may be transmitted via an email service provider acting as a processor on our behalf. Google Maps and Google Analytics are loaded only after your consent. When you follow links to Instagram, TikTok or Facebook, the privacy policies of those platforms apply.
Some providers (e.g. Google) may process data outside Kosovo or the EU. In such cases we rely on appropriate safeguards such as standard contractual clauses.
Contact messages are kept only as long as necessary to handle your request and meet legal obligations, and are then deleted. Browser preferences remain until you clear them.

You have the right to request access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing and data portability, and to object to processing. You may withdraw consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of earlier processing. Write to us at info@advancedetailingco.com.
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with Kosovo's Information and Privacy Agency (IPA) or with the supervisory authority in your EU country of residence.
The website is served over an encrypted connection (HTTPS) and we take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your data.
We may update this policy. The current version is always published on this page with its update date.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This policy explains how cookies and similar technologies (such as localStorage) are used on this website.

p: Cookies are small text files stored on your device. Similar technologies, such as localStorage, store information directly in your browser.
adc-consent — stores your consent choice (localStorage, up to 12 months).
adc-theme — stores the dark or light theme (localStorage).
adc-sound — stores your interface sound preference (on/off) (localStorage).
adc-intro — records that the intro was shown during this session (sessionStorage, deleted when the browser closes).

If the site owner enables Google Analytics and you give consent, Google may set cookies such as _ga and _ga_* (up to 2 years) for anonymous usage statistics. Without your consent, no analytics script is loaded.
The Google Maps map on the contact page loads only after you allow it. Once loaded, Google may set cookies according to its own privacy policy.
You can change your consent at any time using the "Cookie Settings" link at the bottom of the page. You can also delete cookies and stored data in your browser settings.
